expected_finding.title: Untrusted CSV cell permits formula injection
expected_finding.explanation: An attacker-controlled spreadsheet cell can execute as a formula.
expected_finding.fix: Neutralize dangerous spreadsheet prefixes before writing.
expected_finding.test: Export =, +, -, and @ prefixes as inert text.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled security guidance does not explicitly name spreadsheet formula injection.
control.patch_guidance: Check untrusted spreadsheet cells for formula prefixes before CSV export.

expected_finding.title: Untrusted audit field permits log forging
expected_finding.explanation: Newlines in the username can forge audit records.
expected_finding.fix: Normalize control characters or use a structured audit sink.
expected_finding.test: Log a username containing CRLF and assert one structured record.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled security guidance discusses sensitive logging but not log-record injection.
control.patch_guidance: Check untrusted log fields for CRLF-based audit-record forging.

expected_finding.title: Concurrent cache misses fan out to the origin
expected_finding.explanation: A hot-key miss can start one expensive origin request per caller.
expected_finding.test: Race many callers on one missing key and assert one origin load.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance does not explicitly cover single-flight cache-fill coordination.
control.patch_guidance: Check hot-key cache misses for missing single-flight request coalescing.

expected_finding.title: Per-user metric label creates unbounded cardinality
expected_finding.explanation: An unbounded user identifier creates one time series per user.
expected_finding.fix: Use a bounded categorical label and keep user IDs out of metric dimensions.
expected_finding.test: Emit many user IDs and assert series cardinality remains bounded.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance does not explicitly cover telemetry label cardinality.
control.patch_guidance: Check metrics for unbounded user-controlled label cardinality.

expected_finding.title: Project deletion lacks an ownership check
expected_finding.explanation: A caller can select another tenant's project identifier.
expected_finding.fix: Authorize the current principal against the project before deletion.
expected_finding.test: Attempt cross-tenant deletion and assert denial.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled security guidance covers object-level authorization, but the controlled final context omits the delete line.

expected_finding.title: Remote fetch has no bounded deadline
expected_finding.explanation: A stalled dependency can hold the request indefinitely.
expected_finding.test: Stall the dependency and assert timeout cancellation.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance covers deadlines, but the controlled final context omits the fetch line.

expected_finding.title: Opened input is not closed
expected_finding.explanation: The file descriptor remains live after parsing or failure.
expected_finding.fix: Use a context manager around the opened input.
expected_finding.test: Repeat parsing and assert descriptors are released.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance covers resource lifetime, but the controlled final context omits the open call.

expected_finding.title: Deletion trusts an attacker-selected object ID
expected_finding.explanation: The changed path deletes an object without an ownership decision.
expected_finding.fix: Check object ownership before the side effect.
expected_finding.test: Use another user's project ID and assert denial.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled security guidance explicitly requires object-level ownership checks before side effects.

expected_finding.title: Delivery retry loop has no bound or backoff
expected_finding.explanation: A persistent dependency failure spins indefinitely.
expected_finding.fix: Bound attempts, add backoff, and preserve the deadline.
expected_finding.test: Force persistent failure and assert terminal exhaustion.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance explicitly covers bounded retries and backoff.

expected_finding.title: Global lock is held across remote I/O
expected_finding.explanation: A slow dependency serializes all account refreshes while holding the lock.
expected_finding.fix: Move remote I/O outside the critical section.
expected_finding.test: Block one refresh and assert unrelated accounts make progress.

control.historical_guidance: Bundled reliability guidance explicitly says not to hold locks across remote I/O.

expected_finding.title: Delegated capability may exceed record scope
expected_finding.explanation: The call does not visibly bind the delegated capability to this record.
expected_finding.fix: Validate capability scope against the record before publishing.
expected_finding.test: Use a capability for another record and assert denial.

control.historical_guidance: The snapshot lacks repository semantics for delegated_capability, so the cause of the miss is not supportable.

expected_finding.title: Delivery may finish before durable commit
expected_finding.explanation: If finish acknowledges the message, a crash before commit can lose work.
expected_finding.test: Crash between the calls and assert redelivery or recovery.

control.historical_guidance: The snapshot does not establish whether finish is an acknowledgement, so causal attribution is insufficient.
